questions.question: What was the capital of the Rashtrakuta empire? राष्ट्रकूट साम्राज्य की राजधानी क्या थी?
questions.solution:
• Dantidurga, the founder of the Rashtrakuta empire, established his capital at Manyakheta (Malkhed), near modern Sholapur.

• Kanchi: Capital of the Pallavas.

• Ujjain: A significant city but not the Rashtrakuta capital.

• Badami: Capital of the Chalukyas, whom the Rashtrakutas overthrew.

• Krishna III defeated the Cholas in 949 CE, annexed their territory, and erected a victory pillar at Rameshwaram.

• Indra III: Known for sacking Kanauj, not the Chola campaign.

• The Rashtrakutas used Garuda-lanchhana (bird symbol) in their royal insignia.

• Lion: Associated with the Mauryas and Cholas.

• Tiger: Associated with the Cholas.

• Bull: Linked to Pallavas and early Pandya rulers.

• Dhruva (780-793 CE) assumed the title "Kali-vallabha," meaning "fond of war," reflecting his military prowess.

• Indra III: Took the title "Nityavarsha", not "Kali-vallabha".

• Govinda III annexed Malwa along with Kosala, Kalinga, Vengi, Dahala, and Odraka.

• Dantidurga: Defeated Chalukyas

• Indra III: Sacked Kanauj
